cards.question:
Lower bound split semantics

`lower_bound(x)` splits array such that:

- `[0, lower)` is...
- `[lower, n)` is...
cards.answer:
- `[0, lower)` is `< x`
- `[lower, n)` is `>= x`

cards.question:
Upper bound split semantics

`upper_bound(x)` splits array such that:

- `[0, upper)` is...
- `[upper, n)` is...
cards.answer:
- `[0, upper)` is `<= x`
- `[upper, n)` is `> x`

cards.question:
Lower bound first position semantics

`lower_bound(x)` is the first position:

- whose value is...
- after all elements...
cards.answer:
- whose value is `>= x`
- after all elements `< x`

cards.question:
Upper bound first position semantics

`upper_bound(x)` is the first position:

- whose value is...
- after all elements...
cards.answer:
- whose value is `> x`
- after all elements `<= x`
